newsitem.title: UK: Rolling Stones deny they plan U.S. tour.
newsitem.headline: Rolling Stones deny they plan U.S. tour.

text.p: The Rolling Stones denied on Wednesday denied that they were planning a tour of the United States to promote their latest album.
Newspaper reports earlier this week said the British group, who are all in their 50s, were planning an eight-month tour of the United States for next summer.
"We are flummoxed at how the media have blown this up out of nothing. It must be the time of year or something, but it is not true," said a spokeswoman for the band's agent.
She said the band was currently in Connecticut recording a new album. "That could take ages to complete so there are no plans for a tour."
The Stones earned an estimated 250 million pounds ($417 million) from their gruelling "Voodoo Lounge" tour in 1995, which covered 127 venues. ($1=.6003 Pound)
